narr: Scattered showers and thunderstorms developed during the morning hours on September 15th. There was one isolated flooding report in Perry County.
ev: Several roads were flooded in and around Linden including South Mill Street, Brush Creek Road, and several areas on Highway 13.
lsr: SEVERAL ROADS WERE FLOODED IN AND AROUND LINDEN INCLUDING SOUTH MILL STREET..BRUSH CREEK ROAD..AND SPOTS ON HIGHWAY 13.
